source_overlay.scope: Exact reviewed overlay from pinned reference to source iPhone HID + CPH2653 power/mapping lifetime; original event vtables/fields are not accessed

cold_host_tests.scope: Production cold GPIO and raw SEFW parser/programmer under ASan/UBSan/LeakSanitizer. Input/output modes, rail electrical-field preservation, write order, ownership/read/write errors, every truncated firmware extent and programming-write readback failure are checked. No actual PMIC/GENI/firmware execution or cold hardware qualification.

local_geni_transport_overlay.scope: Device-local BSD derivative: command/data/idle completion, bounded cancel/abort/reset ACK and FIFO extent validation; shared source/revision unchanged.

scope: Full source S3910 transport/descriptor/report/key polling + target rail policy, native HID subclass, deferred original-parent loader and one-shot pinned lifecycle. Start/stop use the input gate, with parent cleanup latched before original start, callback drain and deferred provider retention. A concrete source event subclass marks edge origins through bounded original APIs, with deferred Kernel metadata registration, one pinned init/start attempt and exact personality readback. Strict separate combined source kernel; 207 concrete slots read back. Full iPhone private HID/Event ABI, hardware power/DMA/reset, full original device start/element report processing, touch coordinate orientation and UI gestures remain unqualified. No default artifacts or device state changed.
